disputes.reason: The correction teaches a wrong causal link: a small collateralised BCVA does not make interbank counterparties unable to be charged; GARP says charging is not possible for hedging-cost reasons and the small BCVA is only some comfort.

Statement omits which side of the commodity swap the bank is on, so right-way status cannot be judged without the scenario; the correction (right-way only when the producer hedges) is not true for either swap direction.

Describes the stylised OC account of one reading example (pays interest on shortfall, released to equity only at maturity) as a general CLO fact; real CLO OC mechanics differ, so it cannot be judged as written without the scenario.
